title: Shortest Hamiltonian Tour
description: Given a complete directed graph represented by `costs[i][j]`, where travel from city `i` to city `j` costs that amount, find the minimum cost tour that starts at city 0, visits every city exactly once, and returns to city 0.
constraints: The answer fits in a signed 32-bit integer
hints: Use a compact state to summarize each subtree or set of chosen items.
Combine partial states and cache repeated subproblems.
